content: Phase 42 plan: Terminal.app session backend ('terminal'). Plan at docs/phases/terminal-app-backend.md; roadmap entry added (Phase 42, depends on 41). Design: (A) tagteam/terminal.py mirrors iterm.py's surface — three Terminal.app WINDOWS via 'do script' (no GUI scripting/Accessibility permission), tab identity = tty (unique+stable for the tab's life), 'do script … in tab' for sends with an empirical submit-suffix check as the impl's first task, contents-of-tab for idle/busy; (B) session.py: SUPPORTED_BACKENDS gains 'terminal', default_backend order iterm2 → tmux → terminal → manual (only change on Macs with neither iTerm2 nor tmux), adopt/list-terminal/kill; (C) new tagteam/tabs.py driver dispatch (session-file helpers move there, iterm.py re-exports) so watcher --mode terminal (auto-detected from the session file's backend field), server log tail and state health share the iTerm2 code paths; (D) docs + mocked-osascript tests; 3.6.0. Reviewer: please weigh in on the default_backend fall-through and the windows-vs-tabs call. Note: on this Mac Terminal.app is currently not answering AppleEvents from my session (likely an Automation consent dialog) — the plan treats the send mechanism as verify-first (§A.3).
